exampleEn: Please listen carefully to the instructions.
exampleZh: 請仔細聆聽這些指示。

exampleEn: The whole room fell silent when she walked in.
exampleZh: 她走進來時整個房間都安靜了下來。

exampleEn: He decided to enlist in the army after graduation.
exampleZh: 他決定畢業後從軍入伍。

exampleEn: We hung shiny tinsel on the Christmas tree.
exampleZh: 我們在聖誕樹上掛了閃亮的金箔彩條。

exampleEn: She accidentally hit her elbow on the door.
exampleZh: 她不小心把手肘撞到門上。

exampleEn: The temperature dropped below freezing last night.
exampleZh: 昨晚氣溫降到冰點以下。

exampleEn: The doctor examined his bowel for any problems.
exampleZh: 醫生檢查他的腸道是否有問題。

exampleEn: The bus will stop at the next corner.
exampleZh: 公車會在下一個轉角停車。

exampleEn: I found the perfect spot for our picnic.
exampleZh: 我找到了野餐的完美地點。

exampleEn: She planted herbs in small clay pots.
exampleZh: 她把香草種在小陶盆裡。

exampleEn: The mountain tops were covered with snow.
exampleZh: 山頂覆蓋著白雪。

exampleEn: He always opts for the cheaper option.
exampleZh: 他總是選擇比較便宜的選項。

exampleEn: I need to post this letter today.
exampleZh: 我今天得把這封信寄出去。

exampleEn: The child looked as innocent as an angel.
exampleZh: 那孩子看起來像天使一樣天真無邪。

exampleEn: Measure the angle between the two lines.
exampleZh: 測量這兩條線之間的角度。

exampleEn: We can glean useful information from the report.
exampleZh: 我們可以從報告中蒐集到有用的資訊。

exampleEn: The earth revolves around the sun.
exampleZh: 地球繞著太陽公轉。

exampleEn: Exercise is good for your heart.
exampleZh: 運動對你的心臟有益。

exampleEn: Don't let a hater ruin your day.
exampleZh: 別讓酸民毀了你的一天。

exampleEn: The success rate of the surgery is very high.
exampleZh: 這項手術的成功率非常高。

exampleEn: A single tear rolled down her cheek.
exampleZh: 一滴淚水順著她的臉頰滑落。

exampleEn: We watched the stars late into the night.
exampleZh: 我們看星星看到深夜。

exampleEn: There is one thing I forgot to tell you.
exampleZh: 有一件事我忘了告訴你。

exampleEn: Water can exist in a solid, liquid, or gas state.
exampleZh: 水可以以固態、液態或氣態存在。

exampleEn: This soup has a wonderful taste.
exampleZh: 這碗湯味道很棒。

exampleEn: At least ten people attended the meeting.
exampleZh: 至少有十個人出席了會議。

exampleEn: It is wrong to steal from others.
exampleZh: 偷別人的東西是不對的。

exampleEn: Grandma told us old folk tales.
exampleZh: 奶奶給我們講古老的民間故事。

exampleEn: The roof was made of grey slate.
exampleZh: 屋頂是用灰色的石板做的。

exampleEn: The bread had gone stale overnight.
exampleZh: 麵包一夜之間就變得不新鮮了。

exampleEn: She wrote a letter to her dear friend.
exampleZh: 她寫了一封信給她親愛的朋友。

exampleEn: I love to read before going to sleep.
exampleZh: 我喜歡在睡前閱讀。

exampleEn: I dare you to jump into the cold water.
exampleZh: 我量你不敢跳進冷水裡。

exampleEn: Take good care of yourself.
exampleZh: 好好照顧自己。

exampleEn: He won the race by a few seconds.
exampleZh: 他以幾秒之差贏得了比賽。

exampleEn: The farm covers over a hundred acres.
exampleZh: 這座農場佔地超過一百英畝。

exampleEn: She doesn't eat meat on Fridays.
exampleZh: 她星期五不吃肉。

exampleEn: Our team won the championship.
exampleZh: 我們隊伍贏得了冠軍。

exampleEn: He is my best mate from college.
exampleZh: 他是我大學最好的夥伴。

exampleEn: The lion was surprisingly tame.
exampleZh: 那頭獅子出奇地溫馴。

exampleEn: Each item on the list is important.
exampleZh: 清單上的每一項都很重要。

exampleEn: We don't have much time left.
exampleZh: 我們剩下的時間不多了。

exampleEn: A tiny mite crawled across the leaf.
exampleZh: 一隻微小的蟎蟲爬過葉片。

exampleEn: The machine can emit a loud beep.
exampleZh: 這台機器會發出響亮的嗶聲。

exampleEn: The first star appeared in the evening sky.
exampleZh: 第一顆星星出現在傍晚的天空中。

exampleEn: The old barn was full of rats.
exampleZh: 那座舊穀倉裡滿是老鼠。

exampleEn: She studied fine arts at university.
exampleZh: 她在大學主修美術。

exampleEn: The road crew tars the surface every summer.
exampleZh: 道路工人每年夏天都會在路面鋪柏油。

exampleEn: Remember to save your work often.
exampleZh: 記得經常儲存你的工作。

exampleEn: She put fresh flowers in the vase.
exampleZh: 她把鮮花插進花瓶裡。

exampleEn: Birds belong to the class Aves.
exampleZh: 鳥類屬於鳥綱（Aves）。

exampleEn: His face turned pale with fear.
exampleZh: 他嚇得臉色發白。

exampleEn: The frog made a big leap forward.
exampleZh: 青蛙向前一大跳。

exampleEn: We heard the peal of church bells.
exampleZh: 我們聽見教堂鐘聲齊鳴。

exampleEn: The lawyer made a passionate plea.
exampleZh: 律師做了充滿熱情的辯護懇求。

exampleEn: We enjoyed a delicious meal together.
exampleZh: 我們一起享用了一頓美味的餐點。

exampleEn: The horse went lame after the race.
exampleZh: 那匹馬比賽後跛了。

exampleEn: The male peacock has bright feathers.
exampleZh: 雄孔雀有鮮豔的羽毛。

exampleEn: The cathedral has a huge golden dome.
exampleZh: 這座大教堂有一個巨大的金色圓頂。

exampleEn: Switch your phone to silent mode.
exampleZh: 把你的手機切換到靜音模式。

exampleEn: The salesman gave us a quick demo.
exampleZh: 業務員給我們做了快速的示範。

exampleEn: She left a note on the kitchen table.
exampleZh: 她在廚房桌上留了一張字條。

exampleEn: His tone of voice was very calm.
exampleZh: 他說話的語氣非常平靜。

exampleEn: The cat jumped onto the windowsill.
exampleZh: 貓跳到了窗台上。
